latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.2 of the firecrawl-api skill

- Updated security & permissions section: All API operations (scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, agent) now require explicit user approval.
- Added detailed cautions for using browser actions and custom headers, emphasizing user confirmation before execution.
- Clarified the scope of access to include site mapping, structured extraction, and browser sessions.
- Highlighted the potential high credit consumption for large crawls and advised setting reasonable limits.
- No changes to code or functional API endpoints. Documentation only.
